strong_patterns: Yad2 broker-search autocomplete (name known in advance) — near-100% hit rate for direct agency URL when exact name typed
Facebook Pages search with generic Hebrew query 'תיווך נדלן עצמאי' / 'סוכן נדלן עצמאי' — surfaces real small independent agents mixed with duplicates of already-known candidates
weak_patterns: Yad2 location-search directory (city or neighborhood grid) — dominated by franchise brands (REMAX, CITYZEN, Landsman, etc.), true independent single-agent shops are rare (~1 per 15-20 entries) and require manual visual scan for a real headshot + small listing count
Facebook Pages search with a city name appended to a generic query — Facebook's ranking mostly ignores the city qualifier and re-surfaces the same generic-query results already seen
productive_business_types: solo named agent pages (Property/Estate agent category, 100-1500 followers, real headshot)
common_rejection_reasons: GATE_D_WEBSITE — FB page 'Links'/About field lists a live personal domain (2 of 8 deep-checked candidates so far)
GATE_A_RECENCY — most recent visible FB post is >6 months old (2 of 8 deep-checked candidates so far)

Duplicate of already-known prospect — generic queries heavily re-surface names already in qualified-100.json / campaign-chart.csv (2 of 10 discovered names were exact duplicates: ד"ש נדל"ן, עמית בית-דגן, C נדל"ן, איזק נדל"ן, תיווך לאון — 5 total duplicate hits across ~5 queries)

observed_yield_stats.real_qualified_per_hour_estimate: ~1 per 20-30 min of continuous browser-only research given no WebSearch — discovery+verification cost is roughly 8-12 tool calls per fully-vetted candidate, with ~50-75% rejection rate on deep check
